_comment: Every place of one kind in a city, as dots on its real map, drawn by scripts/dot-map.py from OpenStreetMap: the city's land inside its boundary, the land round it, water, the main roads, and one dot per place. No lettering: the film writes its own words in its own look. Sizes are pixels on a 1920-wide picture and scale with the picture.

roads._comment: which highways are drawn, thinnest first, and their width in pixels at 1920 wide
